notes: The Requirements Lab has no standalone normative callback-reentrancy requirement. This Java TCK scenario records only the exception boundary declared by the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 Java API when evokeCallback and evokeMultipleCallbacks are called from reportFederationExecutions. Do not treat this as normative conformance evidence.
